dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward both the anterior and posterior poles.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins exhibit smooth, symmetrical curvature with no visible bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform dark slate-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey mottling across the central and posterior dorsal surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between varying grey tones on the dorsal canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Sparse, small white point-contrast disruptions located on the posterior-central dorsal plane.
